inputs.style: Complex aggressive progressive thrash metal, sharp downpicked guitar riffs, strong audible bass, angular accented live drums, biting male baritone, intricate lead guitar solo. 186 BPM, E minor. asymmetric-feeling riff accents within explicit 4/4, melodic middle section, mounting riff variations and a decisive final chord. Raw heavily overdriven rhythm guitar amplifiers, forceful male English vocals. Complete 280-330 second song, extended developed guitar solo, riff variations, final chorus and decisive heavy ending.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Ash falls like grey snow on the stone
The order signed, the ink is drawn
Burn the ledger, burn the name
Leave no trace of where we came
My hands are shaking, the match is lit
But the pages hide a bitter wit
I fold the truth in wax and wire
And seal it for the coming fire

[Chorus]
Hide the light in the static noise
A world without witness, a world without choice
Broadcast the lie until it breaks
Wake the sleepers for the sake

[Verse]
The dial spins, the frequency climbs
Carving words out of the chimes
They watch me burn, they think it's done
But the signal runs, the signal runs
Every scar is a coded line
Every tear is a design
I am the ghost in the machine
Screaming what they cannot see

[Chorus]
Hide the light in the static noise
A world without witness, a world without choice
Broadcast the lie until it breaks
Wake the sleepers for the sake

[Bridge]
Now the tower hums a low decree
The last transmitter, wild and free
One more breath before the cut
The history of us, the history of us

[Solo]

[Chorus]
Hide the light in the static noise
A world without witness, a world without choice
Broadcast the lie until it breaks
Wake the sleepers for the sake

[Outro]
The screen goes black
The truth remains
In the final chord
It chains
